verdict.rationale: Muse documents "side chats" so users can keep separate context for certain topics as projects grow more complex. That is the product's own topic-scoped context feature. Its VM file system stores the user's files, but no evidence ties those files to a given side chat. Missing for 10: grouping multiple chats and files into a named project or space, shared per-project instructions, file attachment scoped to a project, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
